## Page 3 | Results and uncertainty

```{r, results='asis'}

```

**Table source:** corrected synthetic GreenWaste case. Pilot OLS interval; city extra-change business-clustered interval; local cutoff HC2 interval; matching business-clustered interval treating the selected matches as given.

**Decision rule:** 1,000 AED annual saving per business. Sorted interval endpoints use the positive-saving scale; do not reverse the saving sign without also converting and sorting the endpoints.

<p class="caption">T10 is the source table for this report. The three city rows use shared records; each row must be read with its comparison and requirements in Section 3.</p>
